3) Procurement contact or mailbox for vendor onboarding and supplier forms.

I've attached a draft trial SOW and a short intake checklist that procurement often asks for. If you can share the budget owner + security contact, we'll prepare a one-page pricing & mutual action plan (MAP) to send back by Monday.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.
